T-LOG 2026.08.10 [EN]

🌌 [2026-08-10 15:59]

[STATUS: SPOT | SESSION: OPEN]

The system records intense exchange in the HVN barrier zone of the NQ Probe in the range 29780.0 – 29800.0; a sudden oscillation between capturing barriers and breaking them has occurred. The current price of the NQ Probe is 29795.75, which, with CVD at the level of 8,23K (demand test) and ADR 37.55%, indicates a local struggle for direction. The NDX Star shows an oversold state (CVD: -15,93M), while the QQQ Satellite maintains a demand test phase (CVD: 375,57K). There is a clear stratification of the system: the Core (NDX) is distributing, while supporting instruments (NQ, QQQ) are attempting to build a foundation for demand. The broad TICKQ Exchange shows a "market shot" status (213.00), being significantly above the SMA200 average (123.70), which classifies the Background Radiation (TICKQ) as a "market shot" and "market peak" state. The Q-Score vector is 20 (Probability: 60%), and the Oracle forecasts a high correlation on the 5m scale (64.3%). Volatility in the Dyson Sphere (QQQ) (IV) is stabilizing at the level of 21.15%. Average Action: [BRAK_DANYCH_W_TELEMETRII].
